ModMetaData.description: Reusable Pickle steps that reveal and hide a MainButtonDef through RIMMSQOL's own settings, the way its interface does, and assert what the main bar then draws. Development only: never published, no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See PickleShared/RimmsqolSteps/README.md at the repository root.
